info.name: Get completed site audits

params.name: daysPeriod
params.description:
Number of days in the past from the current moment. Allows you to find site audits completed over the specified period of time. Any number of days can be entered (no limits).
When you leave the field empty, the method will return completed audits for the past 365 days.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of completed site audits and their details for the current subscriber.

info.name: Get site audit reports

params.name: auditId
params.description: The numeric identifier of the site audit report to return.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: The date from which you want to return site audit reports. The format is `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ`.

params.name: toDate
params.description: The date until which you want to return site audit reports. The format is `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ`.

params.name: country
params.description: The two-letter [ISO 3166-1 code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) of the location country.

params.name: locationId
params.description: The numeric identifier of the subscriber's property.

params.name: area
params.description: The audited area within the location.

items.docs:
Returns a site audit report, its part, or several reports for the current subscriber.
**Required parameters:**  • **Option 1**. `auditId`. Use to get a site audit report by ID.  • **Option 2**. The combination of `fromDate` and `toDate`. Use to get site audit reports for a specific period.
***Note:*** Site audit reports are also known as *site planning reports* or just *audits*. See [Site Planning Manager](https://servicechannel.atl

info.name: Get the list of filtered site audits

params.name: searchValue
params.description:
Text field where the following search criteria can be entered:  • Location ID as specified by the subscriber in the location details  • Location name  • Username  • Audit type
The value you enter will be searched for across all these 4 criteria.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: Sequence of pages. Enter `1` to view the first page; enter `2` to view the next page; etc.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of site audits that should be displayed in the response. No limits per page. When left empty, the default number of 20 audits is used.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Optional start date for filtering audits. If provided, only audits created or completed after this date will be included.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Optional end date for filtering audits. If provided, only audits created or completed before this date will be included.

items.docs: Allows filtering site audits by status, location ID, location name, username, and audit type. Returns filtered audits for the last 30 days.
